typography.setup_command: Use Google Fonts for Outfit and Manrope

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Instagram-style explore grid: Masonry layout or a dynamic Tetris Grid (mixing col-span-1 and col-span-2) to showcase 3D projects visually.

surface_strategies: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for Sticky Navigation and Modals: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
Cards: Solid background (#130A24) with 1px border (#281A45), hover effect with subtle neon blue shadow or border-accent glow.

components_strategy.cards: Project cards should be visual-first. Hide text info on default, reveal on hover (like Instagram), or place subtly at bottom. No heavy card containers, just the image bounding box with rounded corners.
components_strategy.buttons: Shadcn buttons heavily customized. Primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white. Secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10.
components_strategy.search_bar: Sticky search bar at the top or prominent in hero, rounded-full, with dark purple background and glowing subtle blue border on focus.

interactions.hover: Scale up slightly (scale-105) on project cards, fade in details.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, favorites toggle, payment submit) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Hero banner with sleek modern abstract 3D render

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette (Midnight Purple and Blue). Set global background to #0B061A.
Implement a main Explore Page with an Instagram-like masonry grid (or varied-span CSS grid) for the 3D projects. Prioritize images; text details overlay on hover.
Create a detailed project view (modal or dedicated page) showing large image, description, and 'Download 3D Files' CTA.
Integrate a persistent search bar in the navbar or hero, allowing users to search by keyword.
Add 'Favorite' functionality (heart icon) on each project, and build a dedicated 'Favorites' tab/page.
Build a 'Payment Methods' settings page where users can add/manage cards or view balances.
Include an Authentication UI (Login/Signup modal or page) with Google, Email, and GitHub options.
Ensure all components use the data-testid attribute for robust testing.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for all iconography.
